items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover like-for-like fittings for the failed indoor heating pipe. Four at €10.50 total €42.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers repair fittings, and the distinct model number does not establish a duplicate. Four at €10.50 total €42.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like fittings used in the repair. The five-piece gross benchmark is €104.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers like-for-like repair fittings. The five-piece gross benchmark is €103.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers the separately specified repair fitting. One elbow is estimated at €21 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers repair fasteners. Eight at about €1.16 total €9.30.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers pipe fixings used in the repair. Four at €4.80 total €19.20, consistent with Case 43.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers these repair fixings. Interpolating between the 10 mm and 25 mm references gives about €5.25 each, or €21 for four.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary trade labour. At the full-cover rate of about €93.20 per hour, 6.75 hours total €629.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers the helper's repair labour. The gross benchmark for all 5.75 billed hours is €409.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover like-for-like pipe replacement. The full invoiced 6.4 m at about €15.40 per metre gives €99.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge for this contractor on this invoice. One charge at the full-cover benchmark is €82.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers installation consumables used in the repair. One flat charge is estimated at €45 gross.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes processing fees added to itemised labour and materials. The conditional estimate is €25 for one fee.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the original insulation. The gross benchmark for the full 6 m billed is €135.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers the mats if they are separate repair materials; §7.1.8(c) excludes them if line 15 already charges for the same insulation. Six at about €20 each total €120 if distinct.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers wire used to secure the replacement insulation. Two billed pieces at €13 each total €26.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary repair labour, and the reported day and a half supports a separate block of hours rather than a duplicate under §7.1.8(c). Seven hours at about €93.20 total €652.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first travel charge for this contractor on the invoice. The conditional full-cover rate for one charge is €82.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes contractor protective equipment. The conditional estimate for one kit is €20 gross.
Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of removed pipe and insulation from the insured repair. One flat charge is estimated at €60 gross.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a) exclude the combined hygiene and coating charge because no tile damage requiring reinstatement is documented. If the entire treatment qualified as repair, five hours at €55 would total €275.
